# Committed golden: byte-exact apple-mode output of scripts/compose-containerfile.sh
# for the synthetic fixture built by the "Committed golden" section at the end of
# tests/contract/compose-layering.sh (team-only nodejs scope exercising comment/
# blank stripping, the FROM/CMD strip, and one DC-EMBED directive with mode 0755).
# It pins the fail-safe default output against pre-change behavior: a diff means
# apple-mode bytes moved and must be deliberate.
#
# Determinism scope: everything here is stable across runs and temp dirs (git
# labels are constant-empty for the suite's non-git fixture dirs; the content
# hash folds file bytes only) EXCEPT the gzip+base64 blob, which is stable per
# machine only (docs claim one-machine reproducibility). The absolute overlays
# dir in the DC-EMBED marker is rewritten to <DC_TEAM_DIR> on both sides before
# the cmp.
#
# Regenerate deliberately (then review the git diff before committing):
#   DCE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 bash tests/contract/compose-layering.sh
# ---8<--- golden body below (test-managed; header text lives in this test) ---8<---
FROM dce-base:latest

# Provenance labels (plans/versioning.md): overlay state at compose time.
# base.id / built.utc are injected at build time via --build-arg.
ARG DC_BASE_ID=""
ARG DC_BUILT_UTC=""
LABEL dce.version="0.2.0"
LABEL dce.scopes="nodejs"
LABEL dce.base.image="dce-base:latest"
LABEL dce.base.id="${DC_BASE_ID}"
LABEL dce.team.content_hash="ef87c30ab2dd"
LABEL dce.team.git_commit=""
LABEL dce.team.git_dirty=""
LABEL dce.team.source=""
LABEL dce.user.content_hash=""
LABEL dce.user.git_commit=""
LABEL dce.user.git_dirty=""
LABEL dce.user.source=""
LABEL dce.content.hash="dba2075375f2044bb8fcc327f82286bfa844579c5a99429fee5e8c9e21441c28"
LABEL dce.built.utc="${DC_BUILT_UTC}"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.revision="dba2075375f2044bb8fcc327f82286bfa844579c5a99429fee5e8c9e21441c28"

# Selected overlay scopes: nodejs

# --- begin overlay:auto:team/nodejs ---
FROM dce-base:latest
RUN echo GOLDEN-PROBE
# DC-EMBED files/golden-embed.sh -> /usr/local/bin/golden-embed (compressed; source: <DC_TEAM_DIR>/overlays/files/golden-embed.sh)
RUN printf '%s' 'H4sIAAAAAAAAA1NW1E/KzNMvzuBKTc7IV0jPz0lJzdNNzU1KTdFNyk+p5AIAsVBeRyEAAAA=' | base64 -d | gunzip > /usr/local/bin/golden-embed && chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/golden-embed
RUN echo GOLDEN-AFTER-EMBED
# --- end overlay:auto:team/nodejs ---

USER dev
RUN mkdir -p /home/dev/.local/bin
RUN cat > /home/dev/.local/bin/dce-entrypoint <<'DC_ENTRYPOINT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
# Chain every installed per-language dependency-sync hook, then run CMD.
for ep in /home/dev/.local/bin/dce-*-entrypoint.sh; do
  [ -x "$ep" ] || continue
  "$ep"
done
exec "$@"
DC_ENTRYPOINT_EOF
RUN chmod +x /home/dev/.local/bin/dce-entrypoint
ENTRYPOINT ["/home/dev/.local/bin/dce-entrypoint"]
CMD ["sleep", "infinity"]
